_: Per-file budgets for raw colour literals in ui/src, read by
single source of colour; ui/ spends tokens, it does not mint them.
A budget is a ceiling, not a target. The gate fails when a file exceeds
its budget, and when a file not listed here carries a literal at all. It
does NOT fail when a count drops: ratchet the number down as debt clears.
'bespoke' means a deliberate exception — canvas and WebGPU read tokens at
runtime through getComputedStyle and cannot use var(), so they carry a
last-resort literal for the case where the stylesheet failed to load.
Those literals must match the token's light-theme value.

ui/src/editor/minimap/Minimap.tsx.note: The minimap paints to a 2D canvas, which cannot resolve var(). readColors() reads --c-fg-primary, --c-bg-primary and --editor-selection-bg through getComputedStyle; each literal is the last-resort value if the stylesheet failed to load and must track the token's light-theme value.

ui/src/graph/gpu/palette.ts.note: FALLBACK feeds readPalette() when a token resolves empty; WebGPU takes packed rgba, not var(). Matches --c-fg-muted (light).
